text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 core performance. Current FixedEffectsEstimates.execute still forms summed precision and RHS, factors and solves per voxel, with optional extra readout solves. PreparedPrecisionRun.evaluate allocates selected run responses and QR coordinates; contribution constructs scaled precision/weighted statistics. This supports profiling the reported path, not attributing the historical 451/1494 MiB totals to any one kernel. The cited selective-estimation benchmark document is absent current main; recover the exact receipt/harness and reproduce against adopted HEAD plus worktree before using old numbers as current evidence. The fallback-status point-lookup defect named by triage is already fixed in this worktree (bd-01M1WVPJ9MMPFDXAY5196E73D7); do not reopen or count it as the remaining pooling bottleneck. Keep full multivariate precision and stable QR residual variance, optional-output suppression, independent mixed-TR oracles and exact provider ownership. Record whole-call and component allocation/time separately before selecting a buffer/batched solve route. No new benchmark was run in this assessment.
